name: Suzushiro Rin
source:
[i]"I'm really happy you two are back.
Welcome home, Princess, Ryuusei."[/i]

The ringleader of the kids on the island, she is two years older than Ryuusei.
A good-looking, kind, and caring girl, she was the first to befriend Ryuusei and invite him into her circle of friends when he moved to Himeshima.
Throughout elementary school,she  went undefeated in the local martial arts tournament.
Perhaps she got her strength and athleticism from her father, who is a farmer.

[Edited from [url=http://ginka.frontwing.jp/en/characters/?rin]Official English page[/url]]
